note: Leitão et al. (2026) evaluates 35 individuals with recurrent dominant RNU2-2 variants alongside biallelic cases, and microcephaly is repeatedly highlighted as a core feature across RNU2-2 cohorts.

evidence.text: Leitão et al. identified RNU2-2 variants in 141 individuals, comprising 35 individuals with recurrent dominant pathogenic variants and 91 affected individuals from 73 families with biallelic variants, noting overlapping clinical features across dominant and recessive forms.

source.title: Systematic analysis of snRNA genes reveals frequent RNU2-2 variants in dominant and recessive developmental and epileptic encephalopathies
source.quote: We report RNU2-2 variants in 141 individuals, including 35 with recurrent dominant pathogenic variants and 91 affected members from 73 families with biallelic variants.

evidence.text: RNU2-2 variants are noted to manifest with microcephaly alongside intellectual disability, epilepsy, and hypotonia across dominant and recessive cases.
